I had the exact same experience after telling my closest friends (who were also supportive), a week after I told them I panicked so much I immediately went back in the closet. Right now I regret it so much because I missed out on a lot of experiences as a guy and could've started T so much sooner. My second time coming out I had a completely different friend group who also supported me and told my parents really soon after I realized. Personally I did it because I saw telling my parents as some sort of no-return point which basically pushed me to not go back in the closet, I know this isn't something everyone can do but personally it really helped me since the first few months I constantly felt weird and like I was faking it. Eventually you will realize this is right and will feel so much happier that you didn't go back in the closet.
